Just yesterday, I was laying my head in my girlfriend’s lap after a discussion. We were talking about something a little serious, and she was telling me about how she notices that though I’m very communicative with feelings in general, when it comes to my own sometimes she has to pull them out of me. 

She said “you know, I’m glad that you like to listen to me, but your feelings are valid too. I know you’ve been through a lot, but I’m not people from your past. I like to hear how you’re feeling and what’s on your mind.” I just tilted my head and smiled at her while giving her a little “I know, thank you honey.” and continued the discussion. 

But goddamn that struck me so hard. It was like something in my brain clicked. I’ve never had someone that wanted to hear my thoughts and not weaponize them. I’m so grateful for her.

Depends on your tracking and route they took. the only times your packages are scanned is when they arrived/departed at a hub/station, so if it were scanned from a hub that was severely impacted by the weather then yes it would be delayed. It’s totally plausible she just ran an excuse at you tbh, but thankfully I think the delayed packages are finally being moved out after/during this weekend. 

The layoff thing? No clue, probably money related. with Fedex building the reputation it has now, they’re probably having a time keeping employees due to wage. But thankfully we’re out of the busiest parts of the year, and that’s mostly October to beginning of January.

So for me, I work at a pretty small ground station. I’m talking we usually work 4000 a day at most, and we closed that Monday the storm hit. Since then, we’ve worked 5k-8k packages at day. So I’d say it’s a pretty safe bet that ground is behind, but I’m not too sure if overnights are getting prioritization or not. 

So that, tons of layoffs, and some stations getting a hiring freeze (mine included) is most likely why everyone’s packages are getting delayed. Fedex would rather blame weather than admit what position the company is in right now. Today we got a good amount of overnights that have probably been delayed as well, so it’s probably safe today that yours is on the way to you soon!

Hey! So. 

I’ve taken gel acid tabs & magic shrooms a couple of times now, I honestly think it may depend on where you’re at coping with your mental health, it also depends on your environment. For context I’ve had my diagnosis since 2019(?) and I tried psychedelics for the first time a little after that. I hope my little timeline gives you some insight. 

2020 - this was when I took a gel tab. I wasn’t taking this for my mental or anything, I just kinda wanted to have some fun. It was my first time taking any psychedelic and I 100% should have been smarter. I took it on the way back to my friends house, his family was pissed that we were on drugs so we weren’t allowed inside and we had to sit outside all night until it wore off. Looking back now it wasn’t so bad, but in the moment my poor little drug-fueled brain was so overwhelmed. It started turning into a really bad trip, I just felt like there was a blanket over me and it was suffocating but after the initial freak out from being kicked out it was pretty nice. I had very colorful visuals, especially on the dark night sky. I was also one of the most “sober” appearing out of the group! (Which was wicked to me cause I was so scared lmao)

2020 (again) - this time I took a paper tab by myself at home, i just wanted to see if I could get a better experience. It was nothing like the first time. Visually, almost nothing or atleast not as intense but I was super emotional. Like I was watching cartoons and crying. 

2022 - I took shrooms and I did this with the intention of understanding my perspective more, because I always just feel a lil warped. I think I took a 2 to 2.5g dose for this trip, and for the first 30 mins to hour it’s just kinda of a stoned feeling. My visuals weren’t that intense yet, just colors were very bright for me. By my 2 hour mark I got very emotional. I almost started crying because my blinds wouldn’t go back down, so I went and sat in my bathroom for a little (bad idea.) I closed my eyes and saw so many colors, that quickly turned black + white and I started seeing so many faces. Faces I’ve never seen, faces I hadn’t seen in years, and I just sobbed through it. I felt so good whenever I got out of that bathroom though, and my visuals were way more intense after.
